nodes.label: Vite Dev Proxy Pattern
nodes.rationale: Routes /api and /ws through Vite dev proxy to backend at localhost:8080, enabling same-origin requests in development without CORS issues. In production these routes are served from the same host so the relative URLs work without changes.

nodes.label: WebSocket Auto-Reconnect Pattern
nodes.rationale: WebSocketClient auto-reconnects after onclose by scheduling a setTimeout call back to connect(). The close() method sets reconnect=false before closing to allow intentional disconnections without triggering reconnect loop.
